note: Thunderwell Core floor v1 art, second look toward reference B (dark teal floor, yellow-green traces as the light, a dozen cobalt chips and two crimson, wider pillar columns, dark walls). Masters are the @2x PNGs, drawn at half size; plain PNGs are the 1x fallbacks. Pixel sizes below are the masters. floor_lift is the exponent on the linear plate (below 1 lifts the dark stone) and floor_grade tints it, both tuned here. room_edge_dark is still a darkness-only vignette with no baked hole. The hole and the wall distance come from the cell footprint: 0 on the board, rising across wall_reach. The room shader draws a dark wall silhouette and a lit rim where the wall meets the floor, then the vignette fades to black. glow_mask is RGB data, lossless, linear, sampled with no source_color hint: R is trace intensity at full range, G is the flow ramp (same rate on every tile), B is 0. The shader uses glow = R * glow_strength * pulse(G), on every cell. glow_color tints traces green near 140 degrees. pillar_color is pale green-white. pillar_strength stays 0.45. pillar_core and pillar_halo narrow the beam into a core plus a soft halo. The sprite is anchored bottom-centre and sorts with that cell. pad_blue_color near 225 degrees and pad_red_color near 350 degrees are the painted hues; pad_strength only scales them. preview_bloom caps the preview glow so a bright pad does not blow the grade out. Floor, pads, pillar and the vignette keep source_color. 2D HDR and bloom are preview-only.
